findings.title: 真实 product_db 首屏及 Android ACK 尚未完成验收
findings.body: The adopted S2 requires the real external host/Rust/Node canonical product DB/authenticated Gateway/physical Android first-screen and ACK chain. The reviewed execution and hash-verified 04:59:59Z evidence show Rust partial with 21 token carriers and 3 developer UnknownEvents, canonical=false, conversations=0/history_items=0, staging_batches=2 and reconciliation_intents=2. App-visible command/cwd came from IPC, and no product_db ACK was observed. The later Rust offline canonical/backfill/restart result belongs to a different execution and test-peer ACK; no new Task005 S2 execution proves the actual Node service loaded that binary and published/displayed/ACKed product history. This is missing acceptance evidence, not a newly identified source defect or a claim the repaired Rust still fails.
findings.recommendation: Use execute-step repair to continue S2: identify/hash the actual service analyzer executable and use the repaired artifact; verify the authorized host/device/feature flags and preserved migration prerequisites; let the existing single collection chain produce canonical product history, then verify authenticated providerMode=product_db bounded initial data, a concrete event value visible on Android and its matching history ACK. Preserve failures and do not force canonical, alter IPC authority, create a second Rust chain or rewrite old reports.
